summary: Ntfy allows you to send push notifications to your desktop or mobile device using simple HTTP PUT or POST requests. It provides a command-line interface, a web application, and an Android client to handle message delivery. The project operates similarly to alternative notification services like Pushover and Gotify.
goodFor: Self-hosters who need a straightforward mechanism to route alerts from scripts, cron jobs, or local services directly to their personal devices without relying on third-party cloud infrastructure.
watchOut: It overlaps heavily with other established notification relays, meaning you should evaluate whether alternative tools already installed in your stack meet your requirements.
deployNotes: As a Go application packaged for Docker and Kubernetes, it typically runs as a lightweight container that generally requires persistent storage for message caching and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
